description: 臺中捷運公車轉乘資訊 [railways and stations and bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺中捷運股份有限公司. 提供臺中捷運公車轉乘資訊涵蓋了臺中捷運系統內各站點之間的轉乘資訊，包括轉乘站點、轉乘時間、轉乘路線等信息。 這個資料集可以幫助乘客更方便地規劃自己的行程，節省時間和精力。 它還可以幫助捷運系統管理者更好地了解乘客的行為和需求，進而優化捷運系統的服務。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 臺中捷運股份有限公司. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
